yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No calendar date is spoken in session 064. November 6–13, 1748 is supplied by YAML. The same-actor lava-river continuation from session 059 establishes continuity, not an independently dated day.
yamlCheck.explanation: The covered adventure resumes at the lava river, proceeds through a short rest and about one hour of travel, includes three dream-wound frames, and ends after days of training with Kenzo’s magical departure. The number of days is not stated, so seven calendar transitions cannot be independently recovered. The dreams and Grash’s attack a year earlier do not add adventure days. The last-light portal description states an operating condition, not the watch when Kenzo arrives. No spoken date contradicts YAML.
